roadmap_rows: | w3-devstack-e2e follow-up 25 | F11-01 first-selection campaign: 32 predeclared fresh attempts, every one kept — kernel IPv4 7 / 1, kernel IPv6 7 / 1, TEST ONLY node-userspace IPv4 7 / 1, userspace IPv6 5 / 3 (pass / timeout). The `::1`-source response with its IPv6 header error occurs only on two successful kernel IPv6 requests and is absent from all eight userspace IPv6 captures. Every fresh timeout has five SYNs at the member tunnel and the node's fvmb0, no origin receipt, completed handshakes and member type-4 data, and ends on a closed node (generation 0 / serving=false; four already sampled generation 0 / serving=false before the request, 1d253f8d had an earlier true heartbeat, 0c27cac0 went from generation 5 / serving=true to 0 / false); the closure cause is unproven, and follow-up 24's IPv4 d556673b stays unattributed. TEST ONLY parent-owned agent wait receipt (launch ID, PID / start ticks, raw wait status, exit code vs signal, wait-observation time) with live exit-0 and SIGKILL readback; D-102 answer for updates. Follow-up 24's 122 files byte-identical; 906 new pins. 2 requests (owner decision / closed-node investigation; updates adopts the receipt). | done (#381) |

| w3-devstack-e2e follow-up 26 | The closed node in devstack 25's timeouts is explained: the TEST ONLY node nft tracer (unscoped IPv6 UDP `meta nftrace set 1` in a foreign mangle table) trips the agent's unchanged fail-closed verifier — `ISOLATION_POLICY_INVALID`, deny baseline, kernel generation 0 while central applied generation stays 5 — and the node recovers at the same generation after removal. Campaign on the kernel fixture, every attempt kept (22 measured fresh stacks): historical tracer IPv4 8 / 0 and IPv6 7 / 1 — ce8ccbe1 closed 1.65 s after proven generation-5 admission, and its first SYN reached the node only after 10.444 s against a 5.003 s deadline; corrected member-only observation 4 / 0 with no closure; two declared tracer-hold probes fail as designed. Every native first selection now starts only after independently proven serving. F14-style passive re-grants 17 / 1: af718646 kept generation 7 serving with handshake 0 through the deadline, a loopback-source type-2 response and one member IPv6 header error, and first node delivery at 5.671 s after a later handshake; 258ba504's cause stays unproven. counterread classifies duplicate owned chains as `duplicate_chain` (`errors.As`, `ambiguous_listing`). The harness stop path matches the shipped budget: supervisor 15 s after TERM, PID1 forwards TERM / INT, 25 s compose grace; live proof exit 0 in 509 ms and a forced SIGKILL after 15.2 s. 4 requests. | done (#386) |

| w4-at-updates follow-up 13 | D-098 first (all 44 follow-up 12 root files of run 2babf9b6 byte-identical under `history/follow-up-12/`). Regression run 759d244a on #369's tree (agent shutdown change; #365's observation not enabled here): **regular AT23–AT27 PASS 5 / 5**, installer 27 / 27, shared-wrapper install exit 0, 13 result POSTs, physical AT26 rollback, uncached-fallback probe. All 11 updater agent stops timed: every stop command returned success (switch stops about 440 ms, repeat stops about 230 ms, in line with run 2babf9b6's stage brackets, which never recorded direct durations); no command timeout; the stored lease kept at every stop and start; five observed exits status 0, five already stopped, AT23's first exit unobserved (reaped before the observer). A pre-test port collision kept under `history/follow-up-13-startup/`; configurable port slot. 1 request (exit-status readback → devstack). | done (#372) |
